decisions.reason: The main-to-sensor signal connector type, pitch, pin count, and pinout are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The sensor-board power input connector and pinout are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source's SPS30 SEL-to-GND configuration and resulting I2C mode are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message Event.
The sensor-board connector matrix does not change the separate power-board charge-status connector or LED circuitry.
The source specifies sensor-board connectors and does not change the main-board panel reset interface.
The source does not modify the main-board connectors or GPIO assignments for panel buttons and the slide switch.
Listing sensor-board connectors and their rail pins does not change the standalone USB regulator, activation condition, powered rail, or specified loads.
The source's sensor-board connector list does not mention or alter the separate PIR input connector.
The source does not change the capacitive-touch connectors, sensors, or GPIO assignments.
The sensor-board connector matrix does not establish or change the addressable LED supply voltage, level shifting, or power-control behavior.
